request: Create one data file per root artifact and append all root and child records; store under <project>/.insrc/usage/<artifact-id>/. Keep usage out of artifact JSON. Consider Avro or Parquet and use existing DuckDB drivers for reporting.
proposedFormat: Avro object container, pending physical schema/library qualification
reporting: Daemon-owned in-memory DuckDB; current Avro driver converts to Parquet cache; direct read_avro requires explicit extension setup and qualification.
supersedes: Embedded meta.tokenUsage collections. Prior review reports and evidence snapshots remain historical, not current design approval.
